what: The one build builds `blaze-thin` and `blaze-engine` and not `blaze-launcher`, which a daemon started with BLAZE_LAUNCH=1 reads from beside the engine binary. Every launched run in a round fails naming the missing file unless the caller builds the launcher itself and copies it beside the engine.
cost: the launcher lane`s revision cases and timing table cannot run in a round as built; a lane had to run cargo in the shared tree inside its command to get the binary
cause: the launcher is a third binary added after the build line was written; nothing lists the binaries a daemon needs beside it
whys: why missing: the build line names two packages
why not caught: the switch is off by default, so no check of a round runs a launched program
property: a binary the daemon loads at run time that the build does not name
class: run-time companion not in the build: a file the daemon needs beside its executable that the one build line does not produce
prevention: the engine names its companions (blaze-launcher) in one list that loop.sh and the release build both read, and the daemon`s start checks each exists and says which is missing
workaround: cargo build --release -p blaze-launcher in the tree, copy target/release/blaze-launcher beside blaze-engine
